title: "Color Pallet"
description: "Generate a color theme from a seed color using color wheel harmonies in the OKLCH or classic HSL space, with contrast checks and CSS export."

```{=html}
<p>Pick how many colors you want, optionally give a starting color, and get a palette built with color science. The generator works in the OKLCH color space, so the colors are spaced by how different they look to the human eye, and every swatch keeps a consistent perceived lightness and vividness. Drag on the color wheel to set the starting color; the large ring marks the seed and the small rings show where each generated color sits on the classic wheel. The eyedropper button can grab a color from anywhere on your screen in browsers that support it, such as Chrome and Edge. Click it a second time, or press Escape, to cancel without picking. On macOS the browser can only sample inside its own window until you allow it under System Settings, Privacy and Security, Screen Recording, and then quit and reopen it. Click any swatch to copy its hex code. Everything runs in your browser, nothing is sent to a server.</p>

<script>
(function() {
  var seedColor = document.getElementById('pal-seed-color');
  var seedHex = document.getElementById('pal-seed-hex');
  var countInput = document.getElementById('pal-count');
  var schemeSelect = document.getElementById('pal-scheme');
  var engineSelect = document.getElementById('pal-engine');
  var rollBtn = document.getElementById('pal-roll');
  var eyeBtn = document.getElementById('pal-eyedrop');
  var row = document.getElementById('pal-row');
  var note = document.getElementById('pal-note');
  var cssPre = document.getElementById('pal-css');
  var copyCssBtn = document.getElementById('pal-copy-css');

  /* ---- sRGB / OKLab / OKLCH conversions (Bjorn Ottosson's OKLab) ---- */

  function srgbToLinear(c) { return c <= 0.04045 ? c / 12.92 : Math.pow((c + 0.055) / 1.055, 2.4); }
  function linearToSrgb(c) { return c <= 0.0031308 ? 12.92 * c : 1.055 * Math.pow(c, 1 / 2.4) - 0.055; }

  function hexToRgb(hex) {
    return [
      parseInt(hex.slice(1, 3), 16) / 255,
      parseInt(hex.slice(3, 5), 16) / 255,
      parseInt(hex.slice(5, 7), 16) / 255
    ];
  }

  function rgbToHex(rgb) {
    return '#' + rgb.map(function(c) {
      var v = Math.round(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, c)) * 255);
      return v.toString(16).padStart(2, '0');
    }).join('');
  }

  function rgbToOklab(rgb) {
    var r = srgbToLinear(rgb[0]), g = srgbToLinear(rgb[1]), b = srgbToLinear(rgb[2]);
    var l = Math.cbrt(0.4122214708 * r + 0.5363325363 * g + 0.0514459929 * b);
    var m = Math.cbrt(0.2119034982 * r + 0.6806995451 * g + 0.1073969566 * b);
    var s = Math.cbrt(0.0883024619 * r + 0.2817188376 * g + 0.6299787005 * b);
    return [
      0.2104542553 * l + 0.7936177850 * m - 0.0040720468 * s,
      1.9779984951 * l - 2.4285922050 * m + 0.4505937099 * s,
      0.0259040371 * l + 0.7827717662 * m - 0.8086757660 * s
    ];
  }

  function oklabToLinearRgb(lab) {
    var l_ = lab[0] + 0.3963377774 * lab[1] + 0.2158037573 * lab[2];
    var m_ = lab[0] - 0.1055613458 * lab[1] - 0.0638541728 * lab[2];
    var s_ = lab[0] - 0.0894841775 * lab[1] - 1.2914855480 * lab[2];
    var l = l_ * l_ * l_, m = m_ * m_ * m_, s = s_ * s_ * s_;
    return [
      4.0767416621 * l - 3.3077115913 * m + 0.2309699292 * s,
      -1.2684380046 * l + 2.6097574011 * m - 0.3413193965 * s,
      -0.0041960863 * l - 0.7034186147 * m + 1.7076147010 * s
    ];
  }

  function oklchToOklab(lch) {
    var hr = lch[2] * Math.PI / 180;
    return [lch[0], lch[1] * Math.cos(hr), lch[1] * Math.sin(hr)];
  }

  function oklabToOklch(lab) {
    var c = Math.hypot(lab[1], lab[2]);
    var h = Math.atan2(lab[2], lab[1]) * 180 / Math.PI;
    if (h < 0) h += 360;
    return [lab[0], c, h];
  }

  function hexToOklch(hex) { return oklabToOklch(rgbToOklab(hexToRgb(hex))); }

  function inGamut(lin) {
    var e = 0.000005;
    return lin.every(function(c) { return c >= -e && c <= 1 + e; });
  }

  /* Keep lightness and hue, reduce chroma with a binary search until the
     color fits inside the sRGB gamut, then return hex plus final OKLCH. */
  function oklchToHex(lch) {
    var L = Math.min(0.98, Math.max(0.02, lch[0]));
    var C = Math.max(0, lch[1]);
    var H = ((lch[2] % 360) + 360) % 360;
    var lin = oklabToLinearRgb(oklchToOklab([L, C, H]));
    if (!inGamut(lin)) {
      var lo = 0, hi = C;
      for (var i = 0; i < 24; i++) {
        var mid = (lo + hi) / 2;
        if (inGamut(oklabToLinearRgb(oklchToOklab([L, mid, H])))) lo = mid; else hi = mid;
      }
      C = lo;
      lin = oklabToLinearRgb(oklchToOklab([L, C, H]));
    }
    return { hex: rgbToHex(lin.map(linearToSrgb)), lch: [L, C, H] };
  }

  /* ---- HSL conversions (classic wheel engine) ---- */

  function rgbToHsl(rgb) {
    var r = rgb[0], g = rgb[1], b = rgb[2];
    var max = Math.max(r, g, b), min = Math.min(r, g, b);
    var l = (max + min) / 2, d = max - min, h = 0, s = 0;
    if (d > 0) {
      s = d / (1 - Math.abs(2 * l - 1));
      if (max === r) h = 60 * (((g - b) / d) % 6);
      else if (max === g) h = 60 * ((b - r) / d + 2);
      else h = 60 * ((r - g) / d + 4);
      if (h < 0) h += 360;
    }
    return [h, s, l];
  }

  function hslToRgb(hsl) {
    var h = ((hsl[0] % 360) + 360) % 360;
    var s = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, hsl[1]));
    var l = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, hsl[2]));
    var c = (1 - Math.abs(2 * l - 1)) * s;
    var x = c * (1 - Math.abs((h / 60) % 2 - 1));
    var m = l - c / 2;
    var rgb;
    if (h < 60) rgb = [c, x, 0];
    else if (h < 120) rgb = [x, c, 0];
    else if (h < 180) rgb = [0, c, x];
    else if (h < 240) rgb = [0, x, c];
    else if (h < 300) rgb = [x, 0, c];
    else rgb = [c, 0, x];
    return [rgb[0] + m, rgb[1] + m, rgb[2] + m];
  }

  /* ---- WCAG 2.1 contrast ---- */

  function wcagLuminance(hex) {
    var rgb = hexToRgb(hex);
    var lin = rgb.map(function(c) { return c <= 0.03928 ? c / 12.92 : Math.pow((c + 0.055) / 1.055, 2.4); });
    return 0.2126 * lin[0] + 0.7152 * lin[1] + 0.0722 * lin[2];
  }

  /* ---- harmony schemes (hue offsets in OKLCH degrees) ---- */

  var ANCHORS = {
    complementary: [0, 180],
    'split-complementary': [0, 150, 210],
    triadic: [0, 120, 240],
    tetradic: [0, 90, 180, 270]
  };
  var L_SHIFTS = [0, -0.18, 0.18, -0.3, 0.3, -0.38, 0.38];
  var SCHEME_DESC = {
    complementary: 'places two hues 180 degrees apart on the wheel',
    'split-complementary': 'keeps the seed hue and flanks its complement at 150 and 210 degrees',
    triadic: 'places three hues 120 degrees apart on the wheel',
    tetradic: 'places four hues 90 degrees apart on the wheel',
    analogous: 'uses neighboring hues in 30 degree steps around the seed',
    monochromatic: 'keeps one hue and walks a ladder of lightness values',
    wheel: 'spaces all hues evenly around the full wheel'
  };

  function clamp(v, lo, hi) { return Math.min(hi, Math.max(lo, v)); }

  function buildPalette(seed, n, scheme) {
    var L = seed[0], C = seed[1], H = seed[2];
    var out = [];
    var i;
    if (scheme === 'monochromatic') {
      var lo = 0.3, hi = 0.88, ladder = [];
      for (i = 0; i < n; i++) ladder.push(lo + (hi - lo) * i / (n - 1));
      var best = 0;
      for (i = 1; i < n; i++) if (Math.abs(ladder[i] - L) < Math.abs(ladder[best] - L)) best = i;
      ladder[best] = L;
      for (i = 0; i < n; i++) out.push([ladder[i], C, H]);
    } else if (scheme === 'analogous') {
      for (i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        var step = i === 0 ? 0 : Math.ceil(i / 2) * 30 * (i % 2 === 1 ? 1 : -1);
        out.push([L, C, H + step]);
      }
    } else if (scheme === 'wheel') {
      for (i = 0; i < n; i++) out.push([L, C, H + i * 360 / n]);
    } else {
      var anchors = ANCHORS[scheme];
      for (i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        var round = Math.floor(i / anchors.length);
        var shift = L_SHIFTS[Math.min(round, L_SHIFTS.length - 1)];
        out.push([clamp(L + shift, 0.18, 0.92), C, H + anchors[i % anchors.length]]);
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  function randomSeedHex() {
    var h = Math.random() * 360;
    var L = 0.55 + Math.random() * 0.2;
    var C = 0.1 + Math.random() * 0.08;
    return oklchToHex([L, C, h]).hex;
  }

  /* ---- color wheel picker ---- */

  var wheel = document.getElementById('pal-wheel');
  var wtx = wheel.getContext('2d');
  var W = wheel.width, CX = W / 2, CY = W / 2, RADIUS = W / 2 - 10;
  var wheelBase = document.createElement('canvas');
  wheelBase.width = W;
  wheelBase.height = W;

  /* Classic hue and saturation disc at lightness 0.5, red at the top,
     hues clockwise. Painted once, then reused under the markers. */
  (function buildWheel() {
    var c2 = wheelBase.getContext('2d');
    var img = c2.createImageData(W, W);
    var d = img.data;
    for (var y = 0; y < W; y++) {
      for (var x = 0; x < W; x++) {
        var dx = x - CX, dy = y - CY;
        var dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
        if (dist > RADIUS + 1) continue;
        var h = Math.atan2(dx, -dy) * 180 / Math.PI;
        if (h < 0) h += 360;
        var rgb = hslToRgb([h, Math.min(1, dist / RADIUS), 0.5]);
        var idx = (y * W + x) * 4;
        d[idx] = Math.round(rgb[0] * 255);
        d[idx + 1] = Math.round(rgb[1] * 255);
        d[idx + 2] = Math.round(rgb[2] * 255);
        d[idx + 3] = Math.round(255 * Math.min(1, RADIUS + 1 - dist));
      }
    }
    c2.putImageData(img, 0, 0);
  })();

  function drawRing(x, y, r, lw) {
    wtx.lineWidth = 2;
    wtx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.35)';
    wtx.beginPath(); wtx.arc(x, y, r + lw / 2 + 1, 0, 2 * Math.PI); wtx.stroke();
    wtx.beginPath(); wtx.arc(x, y, r - lw / 2 - 1, 0, 2 * Math.PI); wtx.stroke();
    wtx.lineWidth = lw;
    wtx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff';
    wtx.beginPath(); wtx.arc(x, y, r, 0, 2 * Math.PI); wtx.stroke();
  }

  function drawWheel(palette) {
    wtx.clearRect(0, 0, W, W);
    wtx.drawImage(wheelBase, 0, 0);
    for (var i = palette.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      var hsl = rgbToHsl(hexToRgb(palette[i].hex));
      var a = hsl[0] * Math.PI / 180;
      var r = hsl[1] * RADIUS;
      var x = CX + r * Math.sin(a);
      var y = CY - r * Math.cos(a);
      drawRing(x, y, i === 0 ? 16 : 10, i === 0 ? 6 : 4);
    }
  }

  function pickFromEvent(e) {
    var rect = wheel.getBoundingClientRect();
    var x = (e.clientX - rect.left) * (W / rect.width);
    var y = (e.clientY - rect.top) * (W / rect.height);
    var dx = x - CX, dy = y - CY;
    var h = Math.atan2(dx, -dy) * 180 / Math.PI;
    if (h < 0) h += 360;
    var s = Math.min(1, Math.hypot(dx, dy) / RADIUS);
    var l = rgbToHsl(hexToRgb(seedColor.value))[2];
    if (l < 0.12 || l > 0.92) l = 0.5;
    setSeed(rgbToHex(hslToRgb([h, s, l])));
    generate();
  }

  /* ---- rendering ---- */

  function formatOklch(lch) {
    return 'oklch(' + (lch[0] * 100).toFixed(1) + '% ' + lch[1].toFixed(3) + ' ' + lch[2].toFixed(1) + ')';
  }

  function formatHsl(hsl) {
    return 'hsl(' + hsl[0].toFixed(1) + ' ' + (hsl[1] * 100).toFixed(1) + '% ' + (hsl[2] * 100).toFixed(1) + '%)';
  }

  function copyText(text, onDone) {
    if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(onDone, function() { legacyCopy(text); onDone(); });
    } else {
      legacyCopy(text);
      onDone();
    }
  }

  function legacyCopy(text) {
    var ta = document.createElement('textarea');
    ta.value = text;
    ta.style.position = 'fixed';
    ta.style.opacity = '0';
    document.body.appendChild(ta);
    ta.select();
    try { document.execCommand('copy'); } catch (e) {}
    document.body.removeChild(ta);
  }

  function renderSwatches(palette) {
    row.innerHTML = '';
    palette.forEach(function(p) {
      var sw = document.createElement('div');
      sw.className = 'pal-swatch';
      sw.title = 'Click to copy ' + p.hex.toUpperCase();

      var colorBox = document.createElement('div');
      colorBox.className = 'pal-color';
      colorBox.style.background = p.hex;

      var lum = wcagLuminance(p.hex);
      var rw = 1.05 / (lum + 0.05);
      var rb = (lum + 0.05) / 0.05;
      var useWhite = rw >= rb;
      var ratio = useWhite ? rw : rb;

      var aa = document.createElement('span');
      aa.className = 'pal-aa';
      aa.style.color = useWhite ? '#ffffff' : '#000000';
      aa.textContent = 'Aa';
      colorBox.appendChild(aa);
      sw.appendChild(colorBox);

      var hexEl = document.createElement('div');
      hexEl.className = 'pal-hex';
      hexEl.textContent = p.hex.toUpperCase();
      sw.appendChild(hexEl);

      var lchEl = document.createElement('div');
      lchEl.className = 'pal-meta';
      lchEl.textContent = p.label;
      sw.appendChild(lchEl);

      var conEl = document.createElement('div');
      conEl.className = 'pal-meta';
      conEl.textContent = (useWhite ? 'white' : 'black') + ' text ' + ratio.toFixed(1) + ':1 ' + (ratio >= 7 ? 'AAA' : 'AA');
      sw.appendChild(conEl);

      sw.addEventListener('click', function() {
        copyText(p.hex.toUpperCase(), function() {
          hexEl.textContent = 'Copied!';
          setTimeout(function() { hexEl.textContent = p.hex.toUpperCase(); }, 900);
        });
      });

      row.appendChild(sw);
    });
  }

  function renderCss(palette) {
    var lines = [':root {'];
    palette.forEach(function(p, i) { lines.push('  --color-' + (i + 1) + ': ' + p.hex.toLowerCase() + ';'); });
    lines.push('}');
    cssPre.textContent = lines.join('\n');
  }

  var ENGINE_DESC = {
    oklch: 'Colors keep the perceived lightness and chroma of the seed.',
    hsl: 'Hues rotate on the classic HSL wheel and keep the seed saturation and lightness.'
  };

  function renderNote(scheme, n, engine) {
    var text = 'This scheme ' + SCHEME_DESC[scheme] + '.';
    var anchors = ANCHORS[scheme];
    if (anchors && n > anchors.length) text += ' Extra colors reuse the scheme hues at shifted lightness.';
    text += '\n' + ENGINE_DESC[engine];
    note.textContent = text;
  }

  var lastSig = '';

  function generate() {
    var n = parseInt(countInput.value, 10);
    if (isNaN(n)) return;
    n = clamp(n, 2, 12);
    var sig = seedColor.value + '|' + n + '|' + schemeSelect.value + '|' + engineSelect.value;
    if (sig === lastSig) return;
    lastSig = sig;
    var scheme = schemeSelect.value;
    var palette;
    if (engineSelect.value === 'hsl') {
      var hsl = rgbToHsl(hexToRgb(seedColor.value));
      palette = buildPalette([hsl[2], hsl[1], hsl[0]], n, scheme).map(function(t) {
        var h = ((t[2] % 360) + 360) % 360;
        var s = clamp(t[1], 0, 1);
        var l = clamp(t[0], 0.02, 0.98);
        return { hex: rgbToHex(hslToRgb([h, s, l])), label: formatHsl([h, s, l]) };
      });
    } else {
      palette = buildPalette(hexToOklch(seedColor.value), n, scheme).map(function(t) {
        var res = oklchToHex(t);
        return { hex: res.hex, label: formatOklch(res.lch) };
      });
    }
    renderSwatches(palette);
    renderCss(palette);
    renderNote(scheme, n, engineSelect.value);
    drawWheel(palette);
  }

  function setSeed(hex) {
    seedColor.value = hex.toLowerCase();
    seedHex.value = hex.toUpperCase();
  }

  /* ---- events ---- */

  function syncFromColorPicker() {
    seedHex.value = seedColor.value.toUpperCase();
    generate();
  }

  /* Browsers differ here: most emit input while the native picker is open,
     while some only emit change once it closes.  Listen for both so the
     swatches and wheel always follow the selected native color. */
  seedColor.addEventListener('input', syncFromColorPicker);
  seedColor.addEventListener('change', syncFromColorPicker);

  seedHex.addEventListener('input', function() {
    var m = seedHex.value.trim().match(/^#?([0-9a-fA-F]{6})$/);
    if (!m) return;
    seedColor.value = '#' + m[1].toLowerCase();
    generate();
  });

  countInput.addEventListener('input', generate);
  countInput.addEventListener('change', function() {
    var n = parseInt(countInput.value, 10);
    countInput.value = isNaN(n) ? 5 : clamp(n, 2, 12);
    generate();
  });

  schemeSelect.addEventListener('change', generate);
  engineSelect.addEventListener('change', generate);

  /* A pointer reports several moves per displayed frame, and every pick redraws
     the wheel and rebuilds the palette, the contrast table and the CSS export.
     Keep only the latest position and spend that work once per frame, which is
     as often as the screen can show it anyway. */
  var wheelDragging = false, pendingPoint = null, pendingFrame = 0;

  function pickPending() {
    pendingFrame = 0;
    var p = pendingPoint;
    pendingPoint = null;
    if (p) pickFromEvent(p);
  }

  function queuePick(e) {
    pendingPoint = { clientX: e.clientX, clientY: e.clientY };
    if (!pendingFrame) pendingFrame = requestAnimationFrame(pickPending);
  }

  function endDrag() {
    wheelDragging = false;
    if (pendingFrame) { cancelAnimationFrame(pendingFrame); pendingFrame = 0; }
    if (pendingPoint) pickPending();      // never drop the final position
  }

  wheel.addEventListener('pointerdown', function(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    wheelDragging = true;
    wheel.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    pickFromEvent(e);
  });
  wheel.addEventListener('pointermove', function(e) {
    if (wheelDragging) queuePick(e);
  });
  wheel.addEventListener('pointerup', endDrag);
  wheel.addEventListener('pointercancel', endDrag);

  rollBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
    setSeed(randomSeedHex());
    generate();
  });

  /* Screen eyedropper (EyeDropper API, Chromium browsers). The button is
     hidden where the API does not exist, such as Firefox and Safari.

     open() takes an AbortSignal, and that signal is the only way to end a
     sampling session from script. Without one, a session the reader starts and
     then walks away from stays live for as long as the tab does, and while it
     is live the browser keeps a screen sampler running. On macOS that is the
     system ColorSampler process, which reads back screen pixels continuously
     and drags the whole window compositor down with it. Three things close a
     session here: a second click, leaving the page, and a watchdog. */
  if (window.EyeDropper) {
    var dropper = null, dropperTimer = 0, dropperOpened = 0;

    /* Nothing in the platform reports whether the browser holds the macOS
       screen recording permission, and without it the sampler opens but reads
       no pixels anywhere, so every click falls through. The one signal
       available is a session that ran for a while and produced no color. */
    var permNote = document.getElementById('pal-perm');
    var permOk = document.getElementById('pal-perm-ok');
    var PERM_KEY = 'pal-eyedropper-hint';

    function onMac() {
      var ua = navigator.userAgentData;
      if (ua && ua.platform) return ua.platform === 'macOS';
      return /Mac/i.test(navigator.platform || navigator.userAgent || '');
    }

    function offerPermissionHelp(openedFor) {
      /* A deliberate cancel is usually quick, so leave those alone */
      if (!onMac() || openedFor < 1500) return;
      try {
        if (localStorage.getItem(PERM_KEY) === 'dismissed') return;
      } catch (e) { /* private mode, just show it */ }
      permNote.hidden = false;
    }

    permOk.addEventListener('click', function() {
      permNote.hidden = true;
      try { localStorage.setItem(PERM_KEY, 'dismissed'); } catch (e) {}
    });

    /* Session is over on its own: drop the timer and the button state, but do
       not call abort() on a controller whose promise has already settled. */
    function forgetDropper() {
      if (dropperTimer) { clearTimeout(dropperTimer); dropperTimer = 0; }
      dropper = null;
      eyeBtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
      eyeBtn.title = 'Pick a color from the screen';
    }

    /* Session is still live and has to be told to stop. */
    function closeDropper() {
      if (dropper) dropper.abort();
      forgetDropper();
    }

    eyeBtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');

    eyeBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
      if (dropper) return closeDropper();       // a second click cancels
      var picked = false;
      dropper = new AbortController();
      dropperOpened = performance.now();
      permNote.hidden = true;
      eyeBtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
      eyeBtn.title = 'Cancel the screen picker';
      /* Nobody spends two minutes choosing one pixel. If the promise has not
         settled by then the session was abandoned, so end it rather than leave
         a sampler running behind a forgotten tab. */
      dropperTimer = setTimeout(closeDropper, 120000);
      new EyeDropper().open({ signal: dropper.signal }).then(function(res) {
        if (/^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/.test(res.sRGBHex)) {
          picked = true;
          setSeed(res.sRGBHex);
          generate();
        }
      })['catch'](function() {
        /* Escape, a click that selects nothing, and our own abort land here */
      })['finally'](function() {
        forgetDropper();
        if (!picked) offerPermissionHelp(performance.now() - dropperOpened);
      });
    });

    /* Closing the tab or navigating away must not strand a session */
    window.addEventListener('pagehide', closeDropper);
  } else {
    eyeBtn.style.display = 'none';
  }

  copyCssBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
    copyText(cssPre.textContent, function() {
      copyCssBtn.textContent = 'Copied!';
      setTimeout(function() { copyCssBtn.textContent = 'Copy CSS'; }, 900);
    });
  });

  setSeed(randomSeedHex());
  generate();
})();
</script>
```

## How It Works

Classic color theory arranges hues around a wheel and builds palettes from geometric relationships on it. Complementary colors sit 180 degrees apart, a triadic palette spaces three hues 120 degrees apart, and analogous palettes take neighboring hues in small steps. These relationships are what designers call color harmonies, and they are the rules this tool applies. For pure hue rotation the named schemes are simply evenly spaced points on the wheel, so 2 evenly spaced colors form a complementary pair, 3 form a triad, and 4 form a square tetrad. The names start to matter when you request more colors than a scheme has hues, because the extra colors then revisit the same hues at lighter and darker values instead of introducing new hues.

The interesting part is the color space where the geometry happens. The familiar HSL wheel treats hue as a plain angle in RGB coordinates, but human vision does not perceive those angles evenly, so two colors that are 120 degrees apart in HSL can differ wildly in perceived brightness. This tool rotates hues in OKLCH instead, a perceptually uniform space where equal distances correspond to roughly equal perceived differences. Every generated color keeps the lightness and chroma of the seed, so the palette looks balanced instead of pairing one neon swatch with a muddy one. For comparison, the color engine dropdown can switch the rotation to the plain HSL wheel, which reproduces the punchier but less even palettes that most online generators produce.

Some vivid OKLCH combinations fall outside what a screen can display. When that happens, the tool keeps the hue and lightness fixed and reduces chroma with a binary search until the color fits inside the sRGB gamut. The contrast rating under each swatch uses the WCAG 2.1 formula, which compares the relative luminance of the swatch against black and white text and reports the better of the two.
